description.en: Vapour pressure-temperature curve showing the elevation of boiling point of a solvent when a non-volatile solute is added.
description.hi: वाष्प दाब-तापमान वक्र जो दर्शाता है कि अवाष्पशील विलेय मिलाने पर विलायक के क्वथनांक में उन्नयन कैसे होता है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Axes -->
  <line x1="60" y1="320" x2="450" y2="320" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- T axis -->
  <line x1="60" y1="320" x2="60" y2="50" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- P axis -->

  <!-- 1 atm Pressure Line -->
  <line x1="60" y1="100" x2="450" y2="100" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />
  <text x="10" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">1 atm</text>

  <!-- Axis Labels -->
  <text x="220" y="360" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">Temperature (T)</text>
  <text x="20" y="220" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563" transform="rotate(-90 20,220)">Vapour Pressure (p)</text>

  <!-- Curve 1: Pure Solvent -->
  <path d="M 80 280 Q 200 180 320 80" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <text x="160" y="180" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#3b82f6" transform="rotate(-30 160,180)">Pure Solvent</text>

  <!-- Curve 2: Solution -->
  <path d="M 140 280 Q 260 180 400 80" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <text x="230" y="200" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444" transform="rotate(-30 230,200)">Solution</text>

  <!-- Intersections -->
  <circle cx="296" cy="100" r="4" fill="#000" />
  <circle cx="372" cy="100" r="4" fill="#000" />

  <!-- Vertical Drop Lines -->
  <line x1="296" y1="100" x2="296" y2="320" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
  <line x1="372" y1="100" x2="372" y2="320" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />

  <!-- Temperature Labels on X-axis -->
  <text x="285" y="340" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">T_b°</text>
  <text x="365" y="340" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">T_b</text>

  <!-- Delta Tb Indicator -->
  <line x1="296" y1="290" x2="372" y2="290" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <polygon points="296,290 304,286 304,294" fill="#000" stroke="none" />
  <polygon points="372,290 364,286 364,294" fill="#000" stroke="none" />
  <text x="320" y="280" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#000">ΔT_b</text>

</svg>

text.hi: विलयन उच्च ताप पर उबलता है
